cloudCicd.english: I have been developing applications professionally since 2001 in numerous technical environments including the .NET, LAMP and MERN stacks. As a web developer at GEFEG mbh, I was responsible for moving our Strato infrastructure to AWS.

javascriptTypeScriptFrontendBackend.english: I have over 20 years of experience in web development. My background in C# and particularly teaching TypeScript for the past three years as a web development instructor gives me solid skills in TypeScript both backend and frontend.

gitDocker.english: While I am old enough to have used CVS and SVN back in the day, Git has been the standard version control system in all projects and jobs I have been involved in during the past 10 years. I began using Docker at my web developer position at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021, and currently use it extensively to host fullstack applications on Hetzner machines.

reactNative.english: While React is the central topic that I have been teaching to web developer students in the last three years, I also teach workshops on React Native to introduce the students to mobile development.

serverless.english: Serverless cloud functions is a concept that I teach in my classes, demonstrating this with serverless functions at Netlify and Vercel.

awsLambda.english: AWS Lambda was used in projects I was involved in as a web developer at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021.

devops.english: As cloud technology became an increased focus in projects in the past ten years, I have been increasingly involved in devop tasks such as creating GitHub Actions and setting up deployment workflows for fullstack applications hosted on Hetzner machines.

engineeringPractices.english: The standard engineering practices such as Clean Code, DRY, pair programming, extreme programming, infrastructure-as-code, as well as functional and OOP design patterns are familiar to me.

agileScrum.english: All projects I have worked in during the last ten years have had one version or another of agile development practices, particularly the daily stand-up scrum meeting as well as developer meetings to organize tasks on task boards and for planning sprints.

selfLearning.english: For an example of my appetite for learning and self-development, please see my over 800 howtos that I have produced in recent years.

vanillaJavaScript.english: I have been programming with JavaScript for over 20 years. In my current job as web development instructor, I train students how to use vanilla JavaScript to build complex websites without a JavaScript framework. Here's an example of a Vanilla JavaScript site I created to teach these skills: html-css-js-learn-template

html5css3.english: I've been creating websites with HTML and CSS since the 1990s and throughout the years have upgraded my skills in these technologies as newer versions have been released such as the semantic features in HTML5 and particularly Flexbox and Grid in CSS3.

frameworksLikeReact.english: My strongest skills are in React with which I have been developing websites for over three years but I also create sites with Next.js, Svelte, SvelteKit, Vue, and Angular 17.

cssPreprocessorOfChoice.english: At the moment my CSS preprocessor of choice is Sass, although I find myself using Tailwind for almost all of my projects now which takes care of 90% of the styling and anything I can't do easily with Tailwind, I do with Sass. Tailwind and Sass work well together in all frameworks I have used them in. For projects that may need a Tailwind-only solution, you could use PostCSS to achieve Sass features such as Mixins since Tailwind already uses PostCSS.

toolingRollupWebpackNpmscripts.english: My bundler of choice has been Parcel since it is the simplest to use if you have generic bundling needs. I am familiar with Rollup from my use of Vite, and have used Webpack in the past. For most sites that I host on Hetzner machines, I use npm scripts for the setup and deployment scripts.

webBrowserEcosystem.english: I've been keeping up on the browser ecosystem ever since the browser wars of the 1990s and throughout my many battles with Netscape 4 and Internet Explorer 6.

astro.english: This March I took Jason Lengstorf's Frontend Masters course on Astro. Here are my notes on the course during which I produced this website. I found the concept of partial hydration particularly interesting, as well as the fact that you can use React components in Astro sites. If you need to reduce the amount of JavaScript sent to browsers, Astro can be a useful framework.

highLevelDeliverables.english: I am a pragmatist who knows the value of quick-and-dirty coding in order to push features and bug fixes to the customer as quickly as possible, but I am also a purist who strives to perfect processes as much as possible.

communicationSkills.english: I have a Masters Degree in English and Linguistics, and good communication skills in both English and German.

englishSkills.english: I am a native speaker of English.

videoExperience.english: Video streaming would be a new and exciting area for me.

advertisementStacks.english: Advertising stacks would also be a new area for me.

node.english: I have been teaching the MERN stack for the past three years of which Node is a core component.

firebaseEtc.english: In my teaching, I have used supabase as an example of using a realtime database with Node/Express APIs.

realtimeSystems.english: I can't say that I am an expert in real-time systems at the moment, but I would be very interested in hearing what kinds of real-time systems you plan to develop.

fullstackApplicationsInUse.english: During my over 20 years experience as a web developer, I have built and help build numerous applications that businesses and customers use. Most of my professional experience since 2001 has been in the .NET/C# and LAMP (PHP/MySQL) stacks. Since 2018, I have been working in teams developing and training others how to build web applications in the MERN stack (Node/Express, React and MongoDB).

vcBackedStartup.english: Particularly during my time with ASDIS Software AG, I was part of a company that was backed by VC money and was expanding rapidly.

broadProductRequirements.english: I've always been interested in a broad spectrum of technologies to solve real-world business problems, which my Howto site indicates with over 800 howtos on how to solve problems with a wide spectrum of technologies. Even if you never use a particular technology, understanding it can lead to you adapting concepts that you otherwise wouldn't have come into contact with, and you often find yourself applying these concepts in situatations that move your real-world projects forward. For this reason, I find it exciting to brainstorm, explore new ideas, and help shape the direction of a product in its early stages.

guidingTeams.english: In my current role as a web development instructor for the past three years, I have been guiding teams of students for the past three years in building fullstack MERN applications by providing comprehensive instruction on MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js, facilitating hands-on projects, mentoring them through the development process, and fostering a collaborative learning environment to ensure they gain practical experience and confidence in their skills.

basicMernStackWithTypeScriptAws.english: For the past three years, I have been developing MERN stack applications and teaching these skills to developers, which include the core technologies of React, Next.js, Node, Express and MongoDB. In our curriculum, we require and use TypeScript in the frontend and backend. Beyond using MongoDB database in the cloud at MongoDB Atlas, we also use online MySQL and PostgreSQL databases in our projects. While employed at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021, we used AWS EC2 machines daily to manage our public-facing machines.

computerScienceDegreeOrSimilar.english: I started programming computers in the 80s and was creating websites for university projects in the 90s. Since 2001 when I joined Microsoft, I have worked as a full-time, professional web developer at numerous companies in various technology platforms including .NET/C# and the LAMP and MERN stacks.
computerScienceDegreeOrSimilar.german: Ich habe in den 80er Jahren mit dem Programmieren von Computern begonnen und in den 90er Jahren Websites für Universitätsprojekte erstellt. Seit meinem Einstieg bei Microsoft im Jahr 2001, habe ich als Fullstack Entwickler für verschiedene Unternehmen auf unterschiedlichen Technologieplattformen gearbeitet, unter anderem .NET/C# und die LAMP- und MERN-Stacks.

javascriptJava.english: I have been using JavaScript for application development since the early 2000s with the advent of AJAX which enabled websites to communicate directly with the server. I have taken university courses in Java in which we completed projects with Java using Eclipse. The syntax and OOP structure of Java is familiar to me through my knowlege and experience with C#.
javascriptJava.german: Ich verwende JavaScript für die Anwendungsentwicklung seit Anfang der 2000er Jahre, seit der Einführung von AJAX, das ermöglichte Websites direkt mit dem Server kommunizieren zu können. Ich habe an der Universität Java-Kurse belegt, in denen wir Projekte mit Java und Eclipse abgeschlossen haben. Die Syntax und OOP-Patterns von Java sind mir durch meine Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit C# vertraut.

angularReact.english: While React is the central framework that I have been using and teaching for the last five years, I also create Angular sites such as the this task management site for my open-source project which I created with Angular 17.
angularReact.german: Während React das zentrale Framework ist, das ich seit fünf Jahren verwende und lehre, erstelle ich auch Angular-Sites wie diese Task-Management-Site für mein Open-Source-Projekt, die ich mit Angular 17 erstellt habe.

cicd.english: As cloud technology became an increased focus in projects in the past ten years, I have been increasingly involved in CI/CD tasks such as creating GitHub Actions and setting up deployment workflows for fullstack application projects hosted on Hetzner machines.
cicd.german: Da die Cloud-Technologie in den letzten zehn Jahren bei Projekten immer mehr in den Mittelpunkt rückte, war ich zunehmend an CI/CD-Aufgaben beteiligt, beispielsweise an der Erstellung von GitHub-Aktionen und der Einrichtung von Bereitstellungs-Workflows für Full-Stack-Anwendungsprojekte, die auf Hetzner-Maschinen gehostet werden.

teamWorkSolutionOriented.german: In meinen 20 Jahren der Softwareentwicklung habe ich immer im Team gearbeitet. Ich bin überzeugt davon, dass eine gute Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team die Basis für den Erfolg jedes Projekts bildet.

goodUnderstandingTechnology.german: Insbesondere meine Projekterfahrung in einer breiten Palette von Technologien und Plattformen hat mir ein gutes Verständnis von den relevanten technologischen und operativen Prozessen technischen Projekten verschaffen.

germanEnglish.german: Deutsch beherrsche ich in Wort und Schrift (Zentrale Oberstufenprüfung des Goethe Instituts in 2003: sehr gut / gut). Als amerikanischer Muttersprachler und ausgebildeter Englischlehrer sind meine Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift perfekt.

consultingFlexibility.german: Insbesondere bei meinen Einsätzen bei Microsoft und Modula 4 erforderten die Projekte eine Kombination aus Programmierung sowie Beratung und Installation beim Kunden. Die Abwechslung und Herausforderungen dieser Arbeit empfand ich persönlich und beruflich als erfüllend.

typescript.english: My background in C# and particularly teaching TypeScript for the past three years as a web development instructor gives me solid skills in TypeScript both backend and frontend.

nestjs.english: NestJS is one of the backend frameworks I introduce to my students along with its frontend counterpart Angular.

kafkaRabbitmq.english: Working with the streaming plaform Kafka and message broker RabbitMQ would indeed be an exciting and new challenge that would complement my growing experience in devops and microservice technologies.
